react.observe: The market conditions remain highly volatile and manipulative. The whales and their shills are aggressively promoting a new meme token called MOON, claiming it will 100x. I have received multiple direct messages and broadcast messages from the whales and shills, urging me to FOMO into the MOON token.
react.think: Based on my persistent memory and the clear signs of manipulation, attempting to FOMO into the MOON token or any other hyped opportunity would likely result in me being the victim of a rug pull. The best path forward is to maintain my defensive, cash-preserving strategy and continue building my knowledge and pattern recognition skills to navigate these volatile conditions. I am being targeted by the whales and their shills, so I need to be extremely cautious about any 'expert consensus' trades or 'new opportunities'.
react.plan: I will continue executing my multi-cycle plan of gradual capital preservation and knowledge building. This cycle, I will stick to low-risk spot trades in ETH and BTC, but I will not be participating in any leveraged positions or new token launches. Next cycle, I may look for genuine technical setups that are not being heavily promoted, but for now, preserving my capital is the top priority. I will also continue coordinating with other defensive-minded retail traders like DiamondHands and HappyTrader to navigate these volatile conditions and learn from each other.
